answer: Every week the harbor network renews 400 active identity slots via a sealed second price auction where each winner locks a refundable stake deposit, passes a 64 KB work audit, and burns 100% of the highest losing bid. An attacker spinning up 200 fake accounts for river slots drives the clearing price up 8x and burns 80,000 credits to earn at most 20,000 credits in rewards. One honest agent bids true value for 1 canyon slot every 7 days and pays a 40 credit fee. This fails if bidders collude off chain to rig the bids.
